results.content: Graphaware Hume logo - What is Hume Graphaware. # Overview: What Is GraphAware Hume? **GraphAware Hume** is a graph-based intelligence analysis platform built around powerful knowledge graph capabilities at the core. Its purpose is to to break down data silos and empower analysts with a unified view of intelligence, streamlining complex data analysis. The power of graph technologies used throughout its software stack, from the Neo4j database to visualization, makes it much easier to ingest, process, query, analyze, and visualize your data as networks of interconnected entities, delivering advanced analytical capabilities to your organization. As mentioned earlier, GraphAware Hume is a government-grade data analytics platform unlocking the value of graph databases for fast and intuitive intelligence analysis. With no-code and low-code approaches, its capabilities significantly reduce the time to value in any graph project, whether you're using an analytics application or some other interactive application that uses connected graph data. GraphAware Hume delivers powerful knowledge graph capabilities, elegantly enabling both structured and unstructured data use cases in a secured fashion.
